description: This file contains helper functions, context managers, and decorators for managing native functions within the torchgen code generation framework, including context management, function wrapping, and handling native function groups.

methods.name: native_function_manager
methods.description: Context manager that sets up context for native functions based on their group or view group.

methods.name: with_native_function
methods.description: Decorator that wraps a function to run within the context of a native function.

methods.name: with_native_function_and
methods.description: Decorator for functions taking two native functions, setting up context for the first.

methods.name: method_with_native_function
methods.description: Decorator for methods that operate on a native function, setting up context.

methods.name: method_with_nested_native_function
methods.description: Decorator for methods that operate on a nested native function (tuple/list), setting up context for the first element.

methods.name: with_native_function_and_index
methods.description: Decorator for functions that take a native function and a BackendIndex, setting up context.

methods.name: with_native_function_and_indices
methods.description: Decorator for functions that take a native function and a dict of BackendIndices, setting up context.
